verdict.rationale: smolagents docs describe an in-session memory object (agent.memory, replay(), step callbacks) for inspecting/modifying steps during a run, but there is no evidence of persisting that memory to disk/database or reloading it across separate sessions or threads. agent.push_to_hub/from_hub shares agent configuration, not accumulated memory. missing for 10: any persistence backend (vector store/db/file) for memory, session/thread resumption APIs, or documented cross-session recall example.
